summary: Frontend-only test of Label Size picker on Daftar Harga (Produk Satuan). Verified all 5 size options, default 4x2, localStorage persistence 'labelSize', reload persistence, custom width/height inputs with comma decimals and clamping (width 2-10, height 1-8), and Label Rak PDF download for each size. Also verified checkbox selection and Batal pilih still work.
critical_code_review_comments: LabelSizePicker custom inputs cw/ch state is initialized from props only once (useState). After the user clamps (e.g. types 15), the applied size becomes 10 cm, but the input text still shows '15' until re-focus/blur. Minor cosmetic issue — the applied text (label-custom-applied) correctly reflects 10 × 8. Consider syncing inputs with the clamped value for better UX.

Non-blocking console warning observed: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. This originates from the Emergent visual-editor overlay injecting <span> wrappers into <option> children (x-ve-dynamic), not from the actual source code. No action needed in app code.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Label size picker fully functional. Default 4x2, options: 4×2, 3×2, 3×1,5, 5×3, Custom. localStorage key 'labelSize' persists across reload. Custom inputs accept comma decimals (e.g. '2,5'), apply on blur, and clamp to width 2–10, height 1–8. printShelfLabels generates Label_Harga_Rak.pdf for every size with no JS errors. Checkbox + Batal pilih + Harga berubah 7 hari button all work. 'Harga berubah 7 hari (0)' is disabled only because the sole product has no recent price change — this is expected.
